    Our story

    Rha Tha Thai (say “Rah Tah Tie”) began when a young chef travelled to Thailand and tasted the country first-hand. Back in Cyprus, she couldn’t keep those flavours as memories.

    After many test batches she recreated the real Thai taste, then tuned the heat to Cypriot spice tolerance, so even the sceptics can give it a try.

    Today the wok runs hot in our little open kitchen in Strovolos, and you can watch every plate being made.

    The cat with the bowl and the chilli is our mascot: calm, hungry, and always ready for one more bowl.
